AccessOps._comment: The connection string is NOT here: it comes from user secrets (Development) or the environment (ConnectionStrings__AccessOps). Logs go to DataRoot/logs.

Hosting._comment: Reverse proxies whose X-Forwarded-For is trusted for the client address in the audit trail. Loopback is always trusted; add your own proxy's address here.

Hardening._comment: Production values. appsettings.Development.json turns RequireHttps off for the http://localhost lab. CspMode: ReportOnly while screens are checked, then Enforce.

Storage._comment: Both folders are outside the web root (the project folder). Relative paths resolve against the project folder.

ShareLinks._comment: The HMAC signing key is NOT here: it comes from user secrets (Development) or the environment (ShareLinks__SigningKey, base64, 32+ bytes). Without one the app refuses to start.

Oidc._comment: External sign-in (OpenID Connect, authorization code + PKCE). The client secret is NOT here: it comes from user secrets (Development) or the environment (Oidc__ClientSecret).

Permissions._comment: Role -> permission map. A new role, or a role that gains a permission, is a change here - not in forty screens.
